content:
[Verse 1 - the single]
@voice am_michael
(break 2)
(slot 2)
I'm simple, I'm the single,
One vowel, one jingle,
The cat sat on the mat,
The hat was on the cat.
The sun is up, it's hot,
I like the sun a lot.
The day is long and bright,
I stay up half the night,
No echo in the middle,
No answer to the riddle.
The rhyme is fine, it's simple,
One dot, without a ripple.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
(slot auto)
Near and far, let the vowels chain,
(they chain!)
Two or more at the end of the line,
Hide a few in the middle lane,
(the lane!)
Stack them up and let them shine.
(break 2)

[Verse 2 - the fix]
@voice af_heart
The cat's an acrobat inside its habitat,
The hat's an artefact, a matter of fact, in fact,
Stack on stack.
The sun is up, the summer's undercover, humming,
The oven of the morning, something's coming, drumming,
The daylight stays, the grey light plays till late,
Then waits.
Same cat, same hat, same sun, the same old day,
The only thing I changed in here was how the vowels play.

[Verse 3 - the chain]
@voice af_bella
A rhyme is not just end of line and done,
It's vowels in a chain, and more than one,
A near rhyme lands inside six syllables,
A far one waits, it's patient, it's invisible,
Then lands.
Two vowels matched, the ending's getting stronger,
Three vowels matched, the chain is running longer,
So stack them in the middle, not just corners of the bar.

[Hook]
@voice bm_george
Near and far, let the vowels chain,
(they chain!)
Two or more at the end of the line,
Hide a few in the middle lane,
(the lane!)
Stack them up and let them shine.
Inside rhyme, outside rhyme, same refrain,
Inside rhyme, outside rhyme, same refrain.
(break 2)

[Bridge]
@voice bm_george
It's woven in the ears now,
The vowels come in threes,
Nobody counts the partners there,
They only feel the pull.

[Outro]
@voice af_heart
Near and far, let the vowels chain,
Inside rhyme, outside rhyme, same refrain.
